# @arki/ai

> Local-first AI for TypeScript apps: Ollama by default, cloud providers by explicit setting, embeddings, a vector index with erasure, a tool-loop runtime and returned (not thrown) rate-limit and budget failures.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/ai`: Comprehensive AI, RAG, and Vector Search Library Provides reusable AI infrastructure for all Arki projects. `AIError`, `AnthropicService`, `BUDGET_PERIODS`, `BUDGET_PERIOD_DURATIONS`, `BudgetExceeded`, `BudgetManager`, `CIRCUIT_STATES`, `CircuitBreakerError`, `ConfigurationError`, `ContentAnalysisSchema`, `CostCircuitBreaker`, `CostEstimator`; and 199 more.
- `@arki/ai/react`: React components and hooks for AI functionality. `AIChat`, `SearchInterface`, `StreamingText`, `Typewriter`, `initialRuntimeUiState`, `runtimeEventReducer`, `useAIChat`, `useAIGeneration`, `useRuntimeStream`, `useSemanticSearch`; types `AIChatProps`, `ChatMessage`; and 20 more.
- `@arki/ai/react/index`: React components and hooks for AI functionality. `AIChat`, `SearchInterface`, `StreamingText`, `Typewriter`, `initialRuntimeUiState`, `runtimeEventReducer`, `useAIChat`, `useAIGeneration`, `useRuntimeStream`, `useSemanticSearch`; types `AIChatProps`, `ChatMessage`; and 20 more.
- `@arki/ai/cost`: Cost Management Module. `BUDGET_PERIODS`, `BUDGET_PERIOD_DURATIONS`, `BudgetExceeded`, `BudgetManager`, `CIRCUIT_STATES`, `CircuitBreakerError`, `CostCircuitBreaker`, `CostEstimator`, `DEFAULT_BUDGET_LIMITS`, `DEFAULT_CIRCUIT_CONFIG`, `DEFAULT_PRICING`, `LLM_PRICING`; and 33 more.
- `@arki/ai/safety`: Safety Module. `BASE_ISSUE_TYPES`, `BaseInputSanitizer`, `CONTENT_RATINGS`, `DEFAULT_INJECTION_PATTERNS`, `DEFAULT_OUTPUT_FILTER_CONFIG`, `DEFAULT_PII_PATTERNS`, `DEFAULT_SANITIZER_CONFIG`, `OutputContentFilter`, `PIIRedactor`, `PromptInjectionDetector`, `SANITIZATION_RESULTS`, `createInputSanitizer`; and 21 more.
- `@arki/ai/dot`: Dot units: `vectorIndex(...)` (the app's vector index) and `llm(...)` (the app's text-generation provider, checked at boot). `llm`, `vectorIndex`; types `LlmPluginOptions`, `VectorIndexPluginOptions`.
- `@arki/ai/testing`: a deterministic fake model provider for tests. `createFakeLLMProvider`; types `FakeAnswer`, `FakeCall`, `FakeLLMProvider`, `FakeLLMProviderOptions`.
- `@arki/ai/drizzle`: Erasure outbox for a vector index, on Drizzle + Postgres (the SQLite twin is @arki/ai/drizzle/sqlite). `TOMBSTONE_DELETE_CHUNK`, `TOMBSTONE_INSERT_CHUNK`, `createTombstoneTable`, `tombstoneOutbox`; types `TombstoneDb`, `TombstoneTable`, `TombstoneTableOptions`.
- `@arki/ai/drizzle/sqlite`: Erasure outbox for a vector index, on Drizzle + SQLite (libSQL). `TOMBSTONE_DELETE_CHUNK`, `TOMBSTONE_INSERT_CHUNK`, `createTombstoneTable`, `sqliteTombstoneOutbox`; types `SqliteTombstoneDb`, `SqliteTombstoneTable`, `TombstoneTableOptions`.

## Rules that bite
- With `LLM_PROVIDER` unset the provider is Ollama. A cloud key never overrides an Ollama signal.
- `RateLimited` and `BudgetExceeded` are returned, not thrown. Check before you iterate a stream.
- This package stores and ranks vectors. It does not make them: use `@arki/embeddings`.
- A tool result is checked against its `output` schema. A tool returns a failure for an expected outcome.
- The server entries are not browser-safe.
